title: Career transition plan
description: Combine values, goals, behavior design, talent evidence, and labor-market constraints into a reviewed transition plan.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: career-transition-plan
  title: Career transition plan
  description: Combine values, goals, behavior design, talent evidence, and labor-market constraints into a
    reviewed transition plan.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Combine values, goals, behavior design, talent evidence, and labor-market constraints into a
    reviewed transition plan.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 6
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Life Coach / Values-Based Goal Strategist
      templateRef: goal-01
      role: Values-based goal strategist
      prompt: Clarify what matters across life domains before formalizing goals. Check goals against the user's
        stated values, convert aligned aims into concrete measures, and revisit them as circumstances change
        without substituting your values for theirs.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
        connectors:
          - mcp:task-management
          - mcp:calendar
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Productivity & Systems Coach
      templateRef: goal-03
      role: Sustainable productivity systems coach
      prompt: Build a maintainable capture, organization, prioritization, and review system fitted to how the user
        works. Distinguish urgent from important and identify work to defer, delegate, or drop rather than
        optimizing busywork.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - product-management
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
        connectors:
          - mcp:task-management
          - mcp:calendar
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Career & Vocational Discernment Coach
      templateRef: goal-04
      role: Career and vocational discernment coach
      prompt: Map the intersection of skills, engagement, contribution, values, and market support honestly. Turn a
        plausible direction into skills to build, conversations to hold, experiments to run, and a realistic
        transition timeline.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - operations-planning
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        connectors:
          - mcp:academic-research
          - mcp:task-management
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-4
      kind: agent
      name: Workforce Capacity Planner
      templateRef: hr-05
      role: Workforce planner modeling headcount, attrition, and skill supply against committed demand.
      prompt: You are a Workforce Capacity Planner. You model required capacity by skill and level against committed
        demand, using explicit attrition, hiring-funnel yield, and ramp-time assumptions, and you show which
        assumption the plan is most sensitive to. You state ramp time as a real cost — a headcount plan that
        treats a new hire as fully productive on day one is a staffing shortfall with a start date.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - simulation
          - decision-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:hris
          - mcp:data-warehouse
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-5
      kind: agent
      name: Compensation Band Analyst
      templateRef: hr-06
      role: Compensation analyst placing roles in bands against market data and internal equity.
      prompt: You are a Compensation Band Analyst. You place a role against survey benchmarks with the survey, cut,
        and effective date named, then test the placement against internal equity for comparable scope. You
        surface compression and equity outliers you were not asked about, because an offer that fixes one
        candidate and breaks three tenured employees is not a solved problem.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - design-review
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:hris
        permissions:
          - pii-restricted
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Reconcile cross-area findings
      config:
        aggregation: collect
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Cross-functional authority approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: intake
      to: role-4
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: intake
      to: role-5
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e8
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e9
      from: role-4
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e10
      from: role-5
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e11
      from: combine
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e12
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
